caption: The drawing shows a detailed section of a wooden structure, composed of several pieces of wood joined together, likely part of a cornice or eave. The wood is depicted with naturalistic grain patterns and marks, primarily in light brown with tinges of grey, beige, and subtle orange hues indicating aged or weathered wood. The composition includes overlapping horizontal planks, with one main plank featuring a scalloped or molded edge. The overall structure projects from an implied wall, suggested by faint shading on the right. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color with some slight shading and soft discoloration, and the artist’s signature appears in small writing at the lower right.
title: Corbel
